cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a Sámi-style knife with a carved reindeer-bone sheath decorated with reindeer motifs and geometric zigzag patterns, plus a leather-wrapped handle — a classic Sámi "leuku"/knife form consistent with the claimed culture and category.

physical.title: knife
physical.summary: Knife and sheath, the knife with single-edged iron blade and wood handle, the sheath of carved reindeer bone and leather. The sheath formed of two pieces of bone, hollowed and incised on one side with three reindeer and zigzag lines, and on the other with interlaced semi-circles, the two pieces held together by two iron pegs at the curved end and by the leather grip at the other. The grip formed of one piece of leather, folded over at the top and pireced with lozenge motifs, sewn togther with integral loop for an attachment thong, and secured by slotting over two projections in the bone beneath.
